vendor.books.selectAllLabel: Select all entries on this page
vendor.books.spokenFull: Balance {balance}. In this view: {in} in, {out} out, net {net}.
vendor.mint.missDims: Measure the parcel — length, width, height and weight.
vendor.mint.sourceLede: Start from a buyer's checkout, or make a label by hand.
vendor.mint.buyerPicked: The buyer already picked their collection shop
vendor.mint.noCheckouts: No checkouts are waiting. Orders from your store's checkout appear here by themselves.
vendor.mint.sourceAloudSome: {count, plural, one {# order is} other {# orders are}} waiting to ship. Tap one, or make a label by hand.
vendor.mint.sourceAloudNone: No orders are waiting. Tap make a label by hand.
vendor.mint.parcelLede: Measure the parcel — the size tier comes from the numbers, so there is nothing to argue about later.
vendor.move.open: Hand it in at another shop
vendor.move.pickTitle: Which shop will you hand it in at?
vendor.move.pickBody: From another shop the price can be different. You see the new price before anything changes.
vendor.move.title: Hand it in at {shop} instead?
vendor.move.dearer: From {shop} it costs {now} instead of {was}: {diff} more comes off your balance, which then stands at {after}.
vendor.move.cheaper: From {shop} it costs {now} instead of {was}: {diff} comes back to your balance, which then stands at {after}.
vendor.move.done: It is handed in at {shop} now
vendor.move.doneDetail: Its new price is {amount}. Print its label again: it names the new shop.
vendor.mint.originFullSub: No place left for a new parcel right now
vendor.mint.originHere: The buyer’s own shop: handed in and collected here, no bus
vendor.mint.fillAll: Fill all four and the tier appears.
vendor.mint.tooBigTitle: Too big for the parcel network
vendor.mint.tooBigDetail: This is dedicated freight — minting sends it to the freight lane (a truck with the right lifting gear), not the PUDO shelves.
vendor.mint.dangerousLede: An order this size goes as a load of its own. If its goods are dangerous, say which kind: the consignment note prints them and the driver needs them.
vendor.mint.dgNote: From the goods’ safety data sheet.
vendor.mint.dangerousFirst: Give the UN number, the proper shipping name and the class first.
vendor.mint.photoNote: The photo is the baseline if anything is disputed at collection.
vendor.mint.freightNote: For the driver at the door (optional)
vendor.mint.freightHint: A heavy or oversized order goes by dedicated freight, and these go on its consignment note for the driver. A parcel-sized order ignores them.
vendor.mint.buyerChose: The buyer already chose their collection shop
vendor.mint.destLede: Tap the shop nearest to your buyer — on the map or in the list.
vendor.mint.buyerPlace: The buyer’s address, or a place near them
vendor.mint.placeHint: The address on the order works — or tap where the buyer is on the map.
vendor.mint.foundExact: Found {where}. The nearest shops are first: tap the map to move it.
vendor.mint.foundApprox: Found near {where}. The nearest shops are first: tap where the buyer really is.
vendor.mint.foundWords: A shop’s three words: the place is marked on the map.
vendor.mint.notFound: We could not find that. Try a street and a town, or tap the map.
vendor.mint.markedTap: Marked on the map. The nearest shops are first.
vendor.mint.originTitle: Where will you drop it off?
vendor.mint.originLede: Every shop is priced against the buyer's collection shop — cheapest first. Your store pin is the orange dot.
vendor.mint.mapDropoff: Map of {count} drop-off shops relative to your store
vendor.returns.title: Nobody collected these
vendor.returns.lede: Waiting at the shop. You can pay to have one brought back, or leave it.
vendor.returns.holdingLine: {trip} for the trip · {shelf} for the shelf so far, and rising each day
vendor.returns.acceptedToast: On its way back to you
vendor.returns.declineNote: It stays at the shop — the goods belong to the buyer, so leaving it is not the same as disposing of it.
vendor.mint.priceLede: Both get it there — you choose what your store pays.
vendor.mint.measuredPrice: Priced on the measurements you entered, not on the size tier — a box that only just tips into a tier pays for what it is.
vendor.mint.happen1: The label, collection code and tracking key are made now
vendor.mint.happen3: The buyer gets the collection code when it is ready
vendor.papers.title: Its papers abroad
vendor.papers.lede: This shipment crosses a border ({crossing}). It goes with its commercial invoice: each item, its weight, its value and the country it was made in, and the buyer it goes to. You print three copies with the label and put them in the pouch.
vendor.papers.currency: The money the goods were sold in
vendor.papers.addressHint: As you and the buyer settled it, up to {max} characters: it is carried exactly as you type it. Leave it empty and the papers name the shop the buyer collects from.
vendor.papers.hs: HS code, if you have one
vendor.papers.declare: I declare that the information on this invoice is true and correct, and that the contents of this shipment are as stated.
vendor.papers.missing: Fill in every item and agree the declaration to mint the label.
vendor.papers.printNote: Put all three copies in the pouch on the outside of the parcel. The shop looks for them before it takes the parcel in; without them it is held at the border.
vendor.mint.noPrepayDetail: Top up on the Orders tab, then release it here.
vendor.photo.failed: The photo did not go — tap to try again
vendor.order.contentsPhoto: What is in it, as you photographed it
vendor.order.contentsPhotoGone: We do not hold a photo of what is in this one.
vendor.toast.freightDetail: This load is too big for the parcel network (class {cls}) — a dedicated-freight job was created.
vendor.toast.mintedDetail: Print it and stick it on the parcel.
vendor.toast.unpaidDetail: Top up, then release the label.
vendor.toast.topUpAskedDetail: Reference {reference}. Your balance changes when the payment is confirmed.
vendor.dock.offerTitle: Let a driver collect from your own door
vendor.dock.offerLede: Instead of carrying every order to a drop-off point, pack them into a bag at your own address and have a driver come to you.
vendor.dock.what1: One trip fewer for you, every single day.
vendor.dock.what2: Your goods are handled once instead of twice — you pack the bag, the driver takes it.
vendor.dock.what3: Nothing about your prices changes. Your door is a place on the route, not a stop that charges a fee.
vendor.dock.notNote: It only works one way: parcels leave from here, they never arrive here. It is not a pick-up point for your customers, nothing is held on a shelf for anyone, and nobody can be sent here to collect an order.
vendor.dock.labelLabel: What should a driver look for?
vendor.dock.labelNote: This is what a driver reads on the job. Name the gate or the door, not just the company.
vendor.dock.zoneLabel: Which delivery zone is it in?
vendor.dock.zoneNote: Routes are planned by zone, so a collection point needs one to be reachable.
vendor.dock.baysLabel: How many bags do you work on at once?
vendor.dock.baysNote: Open bags need room beside you while you fill them. When they are all in use we stop you opening another, rather than letting them pile up.
vendor.dock.cornerLabel: How many closed bags can you keep in a corner?
vendor.dock.cornerNote: Closed bags waiting for a driver can stand in any free corner: say how many, for when a driver is late. With none, each closed bag stands where you work and takes the place of an open one.
vendor.dock.cornerWaiting: {waiting, plural, one {# closed bag waits} other {# closed bags wait}} for a driver; your corner holds {corner}.
vendor.dock.closedWaiting: {waiting, plural, one {# closed bag waits} other {# closed bags wait}} for a driver where you work.
vendor.dock.pinNote: Put the pin on the loading door. It is often not the shop front, and a driver sent to the wrong side of the building has made the trip you were saving.
vendor.dock.pinMapLabel: Map — tap where a driver should pull up
vendor.dock.floorSub: {used} of {capacity, plural, one {# bay} other {# bays}} in use · {free} free
vendor.dock.disabled: No longer collecting from your door
vendor.dock.sealed: Bag closed — drivers nearby have been told
vendor.dock.workLede: Collections leave from here, in zone {zone}.
vendor.dock.fullDetail: You have room for {n} and they are all in use. Close one and hand it to a driver before starting another.
vendor.dock.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting. Paid orders appear here, grouped by where they are going.
vendor.dock.waitsFor: Waits here for room at {hub}: it goes to a driver by itself when there is room.
vendor.dock.sealNote: Closing the bag is what tells drivers near you there is something to collect. Until you close it, nobody is coming.
vendor.dock.stopNote: Bags a driver has already accepted stay with that driver — stopping does not recall them.
vendor.toast.callbackSaved: Saved: your system hears your parcels from now on
vendor.toast.callbackNotArrived: It did not arrive yet. It is tried again by itself
vendor.toast.callbackCodeOn: The callback carries the collection code again
vendor.toast.callbackCodeOff: The collection code stays in the network
vendor.toast.callbackRemoved: Removed: your system hears nothing more from us
vendor.mint.hubsTitle: Or hand it in at a hub, with your other parcels
vendor.mint.hubsLede: For many parcels at once: bring them to the hub on a pallet or in cartons, on a day it receives. No shop and no road before the hub, so it costs less.
vendor.mint.handInTitle: Hand it in at {hub}, with your other parcels
vendor.mint.handInDetail: Book it on an arrival under Dock → To a hub: which parcels, on what, which day. The hub counts what came at its door and scans each parcel in.
vendor.hub.title: To a hub, in bulk
vendor.hub.lede: Parcels you chose to hand in at a hub. Book them on an arrival: the hub counts what came at its door and scans each parcel in. What was not there stays with you, to book again.
vendor.hub.pitch: Many parcels at once? When you ship, choose a hub that takes parcels in bulk as where they start: no shop and no road before it. Then bring them all on one pallet.
vendor.hub.waiting: {n, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} to book for {hub}
vendor.hub.dayHint: Days {hub} receives, on its own clock.
vendor.hub.dayHintZone: Days {hub} receives, on its own clock ({zone}).
vendor.hub.notTaking: {hub} no longer takes parcels in bulk: ship these again from a shop, or from a hub that does.
vendor.hub.bringerHint: Your own people, or the carrier’s name.
vendor.hub.missedLine: {hub} says nothing came on its day. Its parcels are back with those to book.
vendor.hub.feeLine: Receiving {units} costs {total} ({each} each, with fees and tax), paid when you book. What the hub does not count comes back to you.
vendor.hub.emptiesHint: Your empties go back with whoever brings them, on the same visit, once the hub has unloaded them.
vendor.hub.emptiesBack: {units} handed back at the hub’s door
vendor.loads.title: Sent as freight
vendor.loads.notYours: The load this notice is about is not among this store’s loads.
vendor.loads.lede: Orders too heavy or too big for the parcel network go as a load of their own — and a parcel you called off at a hub comes to your door as one.
vendor.loads.refusedRow: Refused at the door: say where the goods go by {by}.
vendor.hub.missing: {n, plural, one {# parcel was} other {# parcels were}} not there: still with you, book again.
vendor.hub.withdrawn: Withdrawn: its parcels are free to book again.
vendor.store.emailCode: Email the collection code to my buyers
vendor.store.emailCodeNote: Only for orders that give the buyer’s email and name. The shop then also checks the name on their ID, so a forwarded email alone hands nothing over. The Send app still shows the code.
vendor.toast.emailCodeOn: The code is emailed to your buyers
vendor.toast.emailCodeOff: The code stays in the Send app
vendor.mint.buyerName: Buyer’s name, as on their ID
vendor.mint.buyerNameHint: Where you email buyers their code, the shop checks this name before it hands the parcel over.
vendor.connect.title: Connect your shop system
vendor.connect.cardNote: Optional. Link your webshop or shop system to SeeBuyGet, so orders become parcels by themselves. Open it when you or your developer are ready.
vendor.connect.lede: You do not need this to ship: you can make orders by hand in the Ship tab. Connecting saves you the typing, once your shop has grown.
vendor.connect.whatTitle: What a connection does for you
vendor.connect.what1: Orders in your webshop become SeeBuyGet parcels by themselves, with their labels: nothing is typed twice.
vendor.connect.what2: Your checkout shows each buyer the pickup shops near them and the exact delivery price.
vendor.connect.what3: Your shop system hears every step — paid, on its way, ready to collect, collected, a problem — and can update the order and tell the buyer itself.
vendor.connect.what4: Fewer “where is my parcel?” questions for you to answer.
vendor.connect.you1: Choose who connects it: your developer, or the company that built your webshop.
vendor.connect.you2: Send them the instructions with the button below.
vendor.connect.you3: When they are ready, make the keys below together, and hand them over in person or through a password manager: never by email or chat.
vendor.connect.you4: Send a test message, and check it arrived: then you are connected.
vendor.connect.sendDev: Send the instructions to my developer
vendor.connect.linkCopied: Link copied: paste it to them
vendor.connect.sendDevNote: It sends a link to a public page with what they need to do. No key is in it: you hand the keys over yourself.
vendor.connect.devLede: Everything they need to connect your shop system. Each key is made only when somebody asks for it here, and a secret one is shown once.
vendor.connect.docs: The full instructions for your developer
vendor.dev.title: Your developer
vendor.dev.note: Invite your developer to sign in on their own: they see only this page, the store’s keys and where its order updates go. Its money, orders and buyers stay yours, and you can take them out at any time.
vendor.dev.name: Their name
vendor.dev.invited: Invited {date}: their link works for a week
vendor.dev.subtitle: Developer access · {store}
vendor.dev.signedInAs: You are signed in as {name}, the developer of {store}. This page is all you see.
vendor.dev.secretOwner: The store’s owner makes the signing secret, with their password, and hands it to you.
vendor.dev.askBody: The store invited you by email. Ask for a new link to sign in: it works once, for a day.
vendor.dev.askSent: If this address belongs to a store’s developer, a link is on its way.
vendor.log.title: History
vendor.log.note: Who did what on this page, newest first. You and your developers see the same list. A key is named by its last characters, never shown.
vendor.log.codeOn: let the collection code ride in order updates
vendor.log.codeOff: kept the collection code out of order updates
